scope: Same held clear LW BON diagnostic state; 45 layers =32 native +13 upper extension. Own 140/128 gpoints remain separate. Common physical bands3-13 only for paired claims.

formulas.legacy_exact_source: A*[B_layer+(B_lower_face-B_layer)*(1-2/x+2/(exp(x)-1))]*layer_fraction, A=1-exp(-x), x=tau/mu. This equals RTE linear-source expression with layer-local face fraction.
formulas.emitter: pi*source_layer_dn(mu)*exp(-sum(tau_below)/mu), summed only within each own spectrum; angular weights integrate 2mu dmu.

limitations: Exact legacy angle removes lookup, thin-layer polynomial and float32 approximations; it is not a reconstruction of the retained native bitwise recurrence (already separately validated).

Both exact emissions use the algebraically shared linear thermal-source closure, with engine-native source fractions and optical depths. Legacy uses layer-local fractions at faces; GP uses captured geometric interlayer fractions.
Own-spectrum common-angle residual still combines optical coefficients, k-discretization and source-fraction interpolation; it is not pure opacity causality or a physical accuracy judgment.
No across-engine gpoint pairing, optical-depth/source swapping, source-fraction renormalization, production source changes or new compiled RTE/replay/model/build.
All-engine totals have different band edges and remain unpaired spectrum totals; the paired attribution is common bands3-13.
quadrature_gate: All successive emitter, per-band, common3-13 total and all-engine-native total changes <=1e-9 W/m2; cap2048.
